proof.text: For the zero truncation, use the identity map on a universe lift of M between zero endpoint modules. The identity gives exactness, the penultimate object is linearly equivalent to M, and the finite-free side condition is vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_resolution_data_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] :
    ∃ S : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (0 + 3),
      S.Exact ∧ IsZero (S.obj' 0) ∧ IsZero (S.obj' (0 + 3)) ∧
      Nonempty ((S.obj' (0 + 2)) ≃ₗ[R] M) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 0,
        Module.Free R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)) ∧
        Module.Finite R (S.obj' (i.val + 2) (by omega)))
